clinical_presentation: Knocked-out avulsed permanent tooth, acute dental/alveolar fracture, or severe localized dental abscess without airway compromise or systemic fever
escalation_action: If airway/swallowing compromised or fever >101F (ESC-01), escalate immediately to Jupiter Hospital Baner or Manipal Hospital Baner / 112

tier_name: Immediate Chairside Haemostasis (ESC-02 Localized Bleeding > 45 Mins)
clinical_presentation: Active bright-red localized post-extraction or oral bleeding persisting beyond 45 minutes despite firm gauze pressure, WITHOUT systemic or airway symptoms
walk_in_window_morning: 09:30 AM - 01:30 PM (and immediate intake during 01:30 PM - 02:30 PM)
fee_policy_reference: Included in post-op follow-up if performed at BrightSmile; otherwise SRV-001 (INR 600) + local haemostatic dressing
escalation_action: Matches ESC-02 (DENT-035): After hours call +91-20-5550-0199; if systemic symptoms (dizziness, fainting, swelling, fever >101F) occur, escalate immediately to Jupiter Hospital Baner or Manipal Hospital Baner / 112

clinical_presentation: Severe spontaneous toothache, acute pulpitis, lost temporary RCT filling, dislodged crown, or fractured tooth without active bleeding
target_response_time: 45 to 90 minutes in reserved emergency buffer slots
operatory_allocation: OP-01, OP-03, or OP-04 standby buffer
fee_policy_reference: SRV-001 (INR 600) + diagnostic RVG SRV-002 (INR 350) as clinically indicated
escalation_action: If buffer slots are full, stabilize pain and book priority next-day morning slot

clinical_presentation: Routine dental check-up, ultrasonic scaling and polishing inquiry, cosmetic whitening inquiry, or non-urgent orthodontic consultation
walk_in_window_morning: 09:30 AM - 12:30 PM (subject to cancellation gaps only)
walk_in_window_evening: 02:30 PM - 07:30 PM (subject to cancellation gaps only)
target_response_time: Same-day only if a scheduled slot opens; otherwise scheduled for next available day
escalation_action: Book confirmed future appointment under POL-BKG-01 (DENT-006) if chairs are fully occupied

tier_name: Afternoon Sterilization Window & Sunday/Holiday Closure Intake
clinical_presentation: Routine/non-urgent walk-ins arriving during 01:30 PM - 02:30 PM sterilization break, Sundays, or the 5 gazetted public holidays
walk_in_window_morning: 01:30 PM - 02:30 PM (Front desk intake only); Sun/Holidays CLOSED
target_response_time: Mon-Sat 01:30-02:30 PM queued for 02:30 PM (except WLK-T1A immediate haemostasis); Sun/Holidays closed
operatory_allocation: No routine chairside seating during sterilization cycle or closures
escalation_action: After-hours/Sunday post-op patients call +91-20-5550-0199 (ESC-02); systemic/airway emergencies (ESC-01) go immediately to Jupiter Hospital Baner or Manipal Hospital Baner / 112
